#MidRangeShot #Patch #Update #Review #FIFAOnline #FIFA #FIFA4 #FCOnline #AndSadly

Mid-range shots are back.

Mid-range shots were completely nerfed with the Next Field update,

but they have been buffed again.

First, let's take a brief look at the patch notes.

First, the speed of the Mid-range D-Shot has been increased.

Second, the trajectory and speed of the ZD Curve Shot have been slightly improved.

Third, the reaction speed of goalkeepers with low stats has been lowered.

So, they buffed the Mid-range Shot in two ways:

They directly buffed it by increasing the shooting stats,

and they indirectly buffed it once again by nerfing the goalkeepers.

With this, I think it will naturally be noticeable.

Let's get into the full review.

snippet.description:
◽영상제보 andsadly@naver.com 

🎵 

#골키퍼 #고급여 #상향 #업데이트 #피온 #피파4 #피온 #FC온라인 #앤새

FC온라인 공지 하나 올라왔습니다.
4월30일 목요일에 패치가 있을거래요.
제목은 '페널티 박스 안 근거리 슈팅에 대한 골키퍼 선방 밸런스 조정'이라고 적혀있습니다.
내용을 보면 박스 안에서 슈팅 때릴때, 
골키퍼 능력치에 따라서 더 잘막도록 개선한다는 거에요.
